faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know about plans, credits, model architecture, and privacy.

creditDef.q: What is a credit and how does it work?
creditDef.a: Credits represent units of computational work. A standard conversational prompt and response typically consumes around 7 credits. Image generation requires approximately 35 credits, and web-grounded search adds a small surcharge (+3 credits). We charge based on what provider models cost to run, with zero markup tricks.

rollover.q: Do unused credits roll over to the next month?
rollover.a: No. Monthly plan credits expire and reset at the beginning of each billing cycle to maintain sustainable, transparent unit economics. If you ever purchase optional credit top-up packs in the future, those remain valid for 12 months.

cancel.q: Can I cancel my subscription inside the app?
cancel.a: Yes. You can cancel at any time directly in your Account Settings with a single click. There are no retention labyrinths or phone calls required. Upon cancellation, your plan remains active until the end of your current paid billing period.

refund.a: If you are unsatisfied with your subscription within the first 14 days of purchase and have used less than 20% of your monthly credit allowance, contact support for a prompt refund. Unused portions of that cycle's credit grant are reversed.

models.a: Klecx is an independent interface built on top of high-performance third-party AI models (currently Google Gemini Flash-class models for low-latency reasoning and specialized image synthesis). We clearly label each model key and never hide what runs your requests.

privacy.q: Is my conversation data kept private?
privacy.a: Yes. Your prompts, responses, notes, and workspace files are private by default. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We do not sell your personal data or use your private conversations to train public models.

featuresPage.heading: Built for how knowledge work actually happens.
featuresPage.subheading: Standard chat interfaces assume conversations are disposable and linear. Klecx provides structure, memory, and precision for sustained thinking.
featuresPage.principlesSubheading: The deliberate decisions behind the Klecx platform.
featuresPage.p1Desc: When you regenerate or edit, earlier answers are not lost. Every response is versioned so you can always step back to inspect prior variations.
featuresPage.p2Desc: Highlighting a passage allows you to explore sub-questions in isolation. Your main workspace remains clean, focused, and free of tangents.
featuresPage.p3Desc: Klecx is an independent user interface connecting you to best-in-class third-party models. You always know what model executes your request and what each turn costs.

aboutPage.heading: Why we built Klecx
aboutPage.subheading: Chat bubbles were designed for messaging friends, not for synthesizing code, legal drafts, or multi-week research.
aboutPage.threadProblemIntro: When working with foundation models, people are constantly fighting the linear chat format:
aboutPage.threadBullet1: You regenerate an answer to get a minor variation, and the previous good response disappears forever.
aboutPage.threadBullet2: You want to ask a question about paragraph 3, so you send a reply — and the model shifts its entire attention away from the original goal.
aboutPage.threadBullet3: Related conversations are buried in a messy chronological sidebar with no way to organize work into folders or projects.
aboutPage.threadProblemOutro: Klecx replaces disposable threads with persistent Workspaces and Projects, gives every response immutable version history, and lets you ask questions directly about specific passages.
aboutPage.disclosureText: Klecx is an independent interface built on top of third-party AI models (currently Google Gemini). We are not Google and we do not claim to own the underlying model weights. We provide a specialized, developer-grade workspace client that unlocks stateful multi-turn reasoning, passage annotations, version tracking, and document exports.
aboutPage.privateText: Your workspaces, prompts, notes, and uploaded attachments are strictly private. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We never sell your personal information or use your conversations to train public foundation models.
aboutPage.noFakeText: We do not display fabricated customer logos, fake user counters, or deceitful “unlimited” badges. Every price and credit metric corresponds directly to what our infrastructure and AI providers cost to run.
aboutPage.supportText: Have questions, feedback, or need enterprise support? Our support team responds to all inquiries within 3 business days.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We believe in clear data practices. Here is exactly what data we store, who processes it, and how you control it.
privacy.storageBody: We collect and store account information (email address, display name, profile image if provided), authentication tokens, workspace metadata, prompts, AI responses, version edit histories, and files you upload to Cloudinary.
privacy.processorsBody: We process your data using dedicated enterprise providers: Google Gemini (generative AI models and inference), Cloudinary (secure asset and image hosting), Resend (transactional email delivery), and Creem (payment processing, subscriptions, and merchant of record). We do not sell your personal data or provide training data to public model pools.
privacy.retentionBody: Soft-deleted workspaces and conversations remain recoverable in your trash for 30 days, after which they are permanently purged from database tables and storage buckets. Automated backups are rotated and expired on a 30-day rolling cycle.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to access, export, rectify, or permanently delete your account and all associated workspace data at any time directly through your Account Settings. If you submit a deletion request, all associated personal records and credentials are erased.
privacy.childrenBody: Klecx is designed for professional and educational adult productivity. It is not intended for or directed at children under the age of 18 (or under 16 in applicable European jurisdictions). We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy inquiries, data subject access requests, or regulatory questions, contact {privacyEmail} or {supportEmail}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: The rules and agreements governing your use of Klecx workspaces, models, and subscriptions.
terms.accountBody: You must be 18 years or older to create an account. You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials and for all activities that occur under your account.
terms.creditsBody: Subscriptions provide recurring credit allocations every billing period. Monthly plan credits do not roll over to subsequent months and expire at cycle reset. Paid credit packs remain valid while your account is in good standing. Refunds may be requested within 14 days of billing if technical issues prevented normal usage.
terms.sharingBody: When you generate a public share link (/s/:token), the conversation is accessible to anyone holding the URL. You are solely responsible for ensuring shared conversations do not contain confidential secrets, credentials, or proprietary third-party data.
terms.ownershipBody: As between you and Klecx, you retain ownership of all original text and content you submit. Subject to applicable model terms and copyright law, you own the rights to the outputs generated by AI models in your workspaces.
terms.disclaimerBody: Outputs are generated by probabilistic machine learning models. Klecx does not guarantee the factual accuracy, completeness, or reliability of any AI-generated response. You must review and verify critical code, medical, financial, or legal suggestions before relying on them.
terms.terminationBody: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate our Acceptable Use Policy. These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Delaware, United States, without regard to conflict of law principles.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use Policy
acceptableUse.subtitle: Required standards for all AI generations, workspace interactions, and shared content.
acceptableUse.prohibitedIntro: To maintain platform safety and comply with partner policies, the following activities are strictly prohibited on Klecx:
prohibitedItems: Explicit sexual, pornographic, or NSFW content generation.
Romantic AI companionship or synthetic intimacy role-play.
Harassment, hate speech, defamation, or promoting violence against individuals or groups.
Malware creation, exploit development, phishing, or cybersecurity attacks.
Fraud, identity theft, unauthorized impersonation, or deception.
Face-swapping, deepfakes, or manipulating the likeness of real living people without explicit consent.
Academic dishonesty, plagiarism, or acting as an 'essay mill' for school submissions.
Any activity that violates local, state, federal, or international law.
Circumventing rate limits, credit constraints, or security safeguards.
acceptableUse.enforcementBody: We employ automated rate-limiting, keyword filtering, and abuse detection. Violations of this policy will result in immediate content blocking, prompt termination, temporary suspension, or permanent account revocation without refund.
acceptableUse.reportingBody: If you detect abusive content, prompt misuse, or copyright infringement created using Klecx, report it immediately to our dedicated abuse inbox at {abuseEmail}. We investigate all valid reports within 24 hours.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: We prioritize privacy and only store essential cookies strictly required to operate the application.
cookies.overviewBody: Klecx does not use third-party advertising cookies, cross-site trackers, or marketing pixels. We only set first-party cookies necessary for authentication, session security, and user preferences.
